spec2def(telephon.cpl telephon.spec)

# telephon.cpl is all Rust (telephon-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/telephon-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# telephon.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/telephon-rust/src/telephon/telephon.rs)
add_cargo_module(telephon telephon-cargo telephon.cpl
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE telephon-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS uuid_sources psdk)
